content_html:
7 new stories in the Rochdale borough since yesterday evening.

The stories

  • Plans Submitted for Demolition of Seven Blocks on Lower Falinge Estate in Rochdale Lowerplace
    Rochdale Boroughwide Housing has submitted plans to demolish seven blocks on the Lower Falinge Estate to make way for 270 new homes, aiming to improve living conditions in the area.
  • Rochdale AFC Manager Provides Update on Injury Situation Rochdale
    Rochdale AFC manager Ian Watson has addressed the club's injury concerns, stating efforts are underway to clarify the reasons behind the current challenges affecting player availability.
  • Rochdale AFC Manager Discusses Challenges After Recent Match Rochdale
    Rochdale AFC manager Jim Watson reflects on the difficulties faced during a recent match, highlighting key moments and the team's need for improvement as they prepare for their next fixture.
  • Rochdale Schools Benefit from Tesco's Free Fruit and Veg Programme Rochdale
    Schools across Greater Manchester, including those in Rochdale, received over 750,000 portions of fruit and vegetables through Tesco's initiative, promoting healthier eating among pupils.
  • Recent Developments in Rochdale Town Centre Highlight Community Engagement Rochdale
    Recent reports from Manchester Evening News detail ongoing activities and business openings in Rochdale Town Centre, providing residents with important updates about their community.
  • Rochdale wins gold and national Britain in Bloom town centre title Rochdale
    Rochdale takes gold and the Town and City Centre category title at the national RHS awards, hosted at Rochdale Town Hall.
  • Venus Lounge in Heywood Wins Restaurant of the Year at National Curry Awards 2026 Heywood
    The Venus Lounge has been awarded Restaurant of the Year at the National Curry Awards 2026, recognising its contribution to the UK curry industry.

Weather: Heavy rain 10°C in Rochdale today.

body:
7 new stories in the Rochdale borough since yesterday evening.

The stories:

Plans Submitted for Demolition of Seven Blocks on Lower Falinge Estate in Rochdale (Lowerplace). Rochdale Boroughwide Housing has submitted plans to demolish seven blocks on the Lower Falinge Estate to make way for 270 new homes, aiming to improve living conditions in the area.

Rochdale AFC Manager Provides Update on Injury Situation (Rochdale). Rochdale AFC manager Ian Watson has addressed the club's injury concerns, stating efforts are underway to clarify the reasons behind the current challenges affecting player availability.

Rochdale AFC Manager Discusses Challenges After Recent Match (Rochdale). Rochdale AFC manager Jim Watson reflects on the difficulties faced during a recent match, highlighting key moments and the team's need for improvement as they prepare for their next fixture.

Rochdale Schools Benefit from Tesco's Free Fruit and Veg Programme (Rochdale). Schools across Greater Manchester, including those in Rochdale, received over 750,000 portions of fruit and vegetables through Tesco's initiative, promoting healthier eating among pupils.

Recent Developments in Rochdale Town Centre Highlight Community Engagement (Rochdale). Recent reports from Manchester Evening News detail ongoing activities and business openings in Rochdale Town Centre, providing residents with important updates about their community.

Rochdale wins gold and national Britain in Bloom town centre title (Rochdale). Rochdale takes gold and the Town and City Centre category title at the national RHS awards, hosted at Rochdale Town Hall.

Venus Lounge in Heywood Wins Restaurant of the Year at National Curry Awards 2026 (Heywood). The Venus Lounge has been awarded Restaurant of the Year at the National Curry Awards 2026, recognising its contribution to the UK curry industry.

Weather: Heavy rain 10°C in Rochdale today.
